text_block_list.text:
Today, a fan event leading up to the 
autumn Tenno Sho is being held.

This autumn, a massive movement—the kind 
seen once in a decade—swept across the 
Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Super Creek. Look, it's Super 
Creek.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's some intense power...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are they scared of me? Why...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: It's Oguri Cap! Here comes Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: O-GU-RI! O-GU-RI!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What is this...?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Let us begin the interviews. First up is 
Super Creek-san, who is in top form right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
How does it feel to stand as a mighty wall 
and confront the hero, Oguri Cap?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: A mighty wall? A hewo...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Is it fine if I just say "I'll do 
my best"?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Oguri Cap is on a 
winning streak straight from the local 
circuit! She's practically a national 
superstar by now.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
The autumn season has finally begun. Can 
you hear the fans cheering for you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'm listening. When I'm not asleep, 
that is."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: O-GU-RI! O-GU-RI!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh...? What on earth is this...
choice_data_list: Super Creek, hey, wait a sec!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? Am I being seen as the bad guy here?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that's the only conclusion I can 
come to.
Yeah, I can't see it any other way.

text_block_list.text:
I could feel it from the atmosphere in the 
venue too... Oguri Cap's popularity is 
truly tremendous.
Super Creek might be seen as an antihero.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"It feels just like back then. During the 
spring of the Classic year, when I was in 
poor form and everyone treated me so 
coldly..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, more importantly~, would you mind 
leaving this to me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I have a little idea. I'll go ahead and 
share it in front of everyone now. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, everyone. You'd be making a big 
mistake if you think Oguri-chan is the 
strongest♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In the autumn 'Tenno Sho', Trainer-san and 
I are going to completely beat Oguri-chan 
down♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a worthy opponent indeed. Super 
Creek.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let us clash with every ounce of strength 
we possess. I will not lose.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: O-GU-RI! O-GU-RI!

A sudden, bold declaration. When I ask for 
her reasons...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it just crossed my mind. I wondered 
if saying that would make everyone happy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then I'd really love to do it for them. I 
just love bringing smiles to everyone's 
faces.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If we can achieve that through the 
races... it's fine even if I get a little 
disliked, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Back that spring, I didn't have the leeway 
for that, but the me right now will be 
just fine.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
After all, there's so much that you and I 
have built up together, Trainer! ♪

"...It seems she decided to play the 
villain for the fans' sake. The kindest 
villain in the world."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer, will you let them hate you 
along with me? And then...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let us achieve results so great in our 
races that they're downright enviable. It 
won't get exciting unless we're strong, 
after all.

An unprecedented Oguri boom. Super Creek 
was ready to envelop it all with boundless 
love.
